title: React v2 Skeleton Loaders & Page Transitions: Seamless loading experience
goal: Replace any rudimentary loading spinners with glowing skeleton loaders that mimic the shape of the content being loaded (e.g., table row skeletons, card skeletons). Additionally, implement smooth fade/slide page transitions when navigating between routes using Framer Motion or native view transitions. This ensures the app never feels 'stuck' or jerky.
